name: ORBITAL SHAKER INCUBATOR
desc: Benchtop Microprocessor-Controlled Orbital Shaker Incubator engineered to provide a strictly controlled thermal and mixing environment for cell cultures. Features a 100-liter SS 304 internal chamber, large 400x400 mm platform, and digital PID control for temps from Ambient plus 5°C up to 70°C.
features: Ambient plus 5°C to 70°C highly accurate incubation span
20 to 250 RPM smooth digital velocity configuration
Large 400x400 mm shaking platform supporting up to 50 Kg load
Accommodates up to 16 × 250 mL Conical Flasks simultaneously
Transparent Toughened Glass Door for seamless process viewing
